title: Write unit tests for select_batch() — no-overlap and overlap cases
description: Create tests/test_batch_manager.py with two synchronous pytest test functions covering the select_batch() domain-overlap logic. No mocking required — select_batch() is a pure function. Tests must not import from orchestrator, planner, or gatherer to keep them dependency-light.
acceptance_criteria: test_select_batch_no_overlap: given 3 WUs with fully disjoint solution_domains, all 3 are returned in the batch
test_select_batch_with_overlap: given WU-A and WU-C sharing a file, and WU-B with no overlap, the batch contains WU-A and WU-B but not WU-C
A third test verifies that MAX_BATCH_SIZE caps the result even when all domains are disjoint

implementer_report.summary: Created tests/test_batch_manager.py with three synchronous pytest functions covering select_batch() domain-overlap logic: (1) test_select_batch_no_overlap verifies all 3 disjoint WUs are returned, (2) test_select_batch_with_overlap verifies WU-C is excluded when it shares a file with WU-A while WU-B is kept, (3) test_select_batch_max_batch_size verifies the batch is capped at MAX_BATCH_SIZE even when all 7 candidate WUs are fully disjoint. Also created tests/__init__.py. No imports from orchestrator, planner, or gatherer.
implementer_report.commit_message: test(WU-004): add unit tests for select_batch() no-overlap, overlap, and size-cap cases
